Why Clubs Buy Rugby Kit From Sialkot

Rugby kit is a construction test: shoulder seams that take cleanouts, collars that survive a season of scrums, sublimation that doesn't fade in mud and wash cycles. Sialkot's sports-manufacturing cluster - the city that produces most of the world's hand-stitched footballs - has built contact-sport gear for decades, and that stitching depth is exactly what rugby demands.

For a club that means 15–20 set runs (the quantity resellers in the UK and Australia mark up heavily because they import from here anyway), factory-direct pricing, and DDP delivery to the clubhouse in 3–7 days. Test the build quality first with a 20-piece trial, or see the wider sportswear range.

Rugby Kit Questions

What makes a rugby jersey different from a normal sports jersey?

Construction. Rugby jerseys use heavier twisted-yarn polyester (200-260 GSM vs 140-160 for soccer), reinforced shoulder and side seams, and a tighter modern cut so there is less fabric to grab. Sublimated graphics are printed into the fibre so season-long contact cannot crack or peel them.

What is the minimum order for custom rugby kits?

15-20 sets per design - one club side including spares. Training wear starts at 20 pieces and off-field teamwear at 50 pieces with a 20-piece trial option.

How much does a custom rugby kit cost?

Quoted per design within 24 hours; comparable sublimated-set baselines on our published pricing page run $14-16 per set at kit MOQs, with rugby-spec reinforcement quoted on top. Volume discounts apply from 100 pieces.

Can you match our existing club colors and sponsors?

Yes - send any photo of your current kit plus sponsor logos and we return a free mockup in 24-48 hours, with Pantone-matched colors and sponsor placements exactly where your league regulations allow.

How long does a rugby kit order take?

Free mockup in 24-48 hours, sample in 5-7 business days, production 2-3 weeks, DDP express delivery 3-7 days - comfortably inside a pre-season window.
